name: clipboard-persist-simple
description: R3-FEAT-1: verify the item clipboard (copy/paste) persists to localStorage (hdb_clipboard) across a real page reload, and that paste after switching to a different design re-resolves against the current catalog with a fresh id, skipping an unresolvable copied def gracefully.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; try { localStorage.removeItem('hdb_clipboard') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: add-item
steps.eval: (function(){ const id = window.__store.getState().addItem({ defId:'armchair', position:[0.5,0.5], rotation:0, props:{} }); window.__armchairId = id; window.__store.getState().setSelectedItemIds([id]); })()

steps.name: copy-item
steps.eval: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyC', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true }))

steps.name: verify-persisted-to-localstorage
steps.eval: (function(){ const raw = localStorage.getItem('hdb_clipboard'); if (!raw) throw new Error('hdb_clipboard was not written on copy'); const parsed = JSON.parse(raw); if (!Array.isArray(parsed) || parsed[0]?.defId !== 'armchair') throw new Error('unexpected persisted clipboard: ' + raw); console.log('hdb_clipboard persisted:', raw); })()

steps.name: dismiss-overlays-after-reload
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-clipboard-survived-reload
steps.failMessage: Clipboard did not survive a real reload (R3-FEAT-1 regression) — expected localStorage hydration on boot

steps.name: verify-different-design-is-empty
steps.failMessage: resetToEmpty did not clear items — cannot simulate a different (empty) design

steps.name: paste-cross-plan
steps.eval: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyV', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true }))

steps.name: verify-pasted-fresh-id-cross-plan
steps.failMessage: Cross-plan paste did not reconstruct the armchair with a fresh id in the new (different) design

steps.name: paste-unresolvable
steps.eval: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyV', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true }))

steps.name: verify-unresolvable-def-skipped-gracefully
steps.eval: (function(){ const n = window.__store.getState().items.length; if (n !== window.__preBadPasteCount) throw new Error('Pasting an unresolvable defId should no-op, but item count changed from ' + window.__preBadPasteCount + ' to ' + n); })()
